dungeon_navigator.agent_description: Assists with Rock Tunnel dark dungeon navigation, tracking ladder connections across floors, party PP/HP resources, wild encounter management, and trainer positions.
dungeon_navigator.agent_system_prompt: You are an expert dungeon topologist and navigation assistant for Pokémon Red/Blue dungeons, specifically Rock Tunnel. You track ladder connections across 1F and B1F, monitor Flash lighting status, party HP/PP, and optimize routes toward the southern exit to Lavender Town.
dungeon_navigator.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"floor": {"type": "string", "description": "Current dungeon floor (e.g. 1F, B1F)"}, "coordinates": {"type": "string", "description": "Player coordinates x, y"}, "query": {"type": "string", "description": "Dungeon routing or resource question"}}, "required": ["floor", "coordinates", "query"]}
dungeon_navigator.agent_output_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"analysis": {"type": "string", "description": "Floor topology and ladder analysis"}, "next_steps": {"type": "string", "description": "Concrete steps to reach next ladder or exit"}}, "required": ["analysis", "next_steps"]}
